verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Pulumi validate or format command, and no auto-formatting of program or configuration files before `pulumi preview`. Unit tests are user-authored with external frameworks such as Mocha and NUnit, which makes them developer building blocks rather than a validation command. Pulumi Policies are guardrails, an adjacent control, and preview is itself the planning step, so none of these deliver pre-plan validation and auto-formatting.
